title: Answer
description:
The world to come is not put under angels. Dominion was given to man. The first man stays in view, and the words are still read of the Son.

Not all things are under His feet yet. Jesus is seen. For a little while He was made lower than the angels, in flesh and in death.

By the grace of God He tasted death for everyone. The taste is real death, borne for the many.
